title: gelseminum insigne
intro: Gelseminum insigne, commonly known as Yellow Jasmine or Evening Primrose, is a plant species native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Gelseminum insigne are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
